findings.source_quote: “the sands of worldliness that shallow the current”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “shallow” with “ufanya mkondo kuwa wa kina kifupi” so the sentence reads: “Miamsho itakayoliinua juu ya mchanga wa mambo ya kidunia ambao hufanya mkondo kuwa wa kina kifupi na kuzuia safari.”
findings.translation_quote: “mchanga wa mambo ya kidunia ambao hufanya mkondo kuwa shallow na kuzuia safari”

findings.source_quote: “the spirit of supplies, of grace, and mercy”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “roho ya mahitaji” with “roho ya utoaji” to convey provision rather than need.
